moisture_pct.quote: **Water: 41.01 g / 100 g = 41.01 %** – Cheese, monterey, per 100 g

fat_pct.quote: **Total lipid (fat): 30.28 g / 100 g = 30.28 %** – Cheese, monterey, per 100 g

ph.quote: `pH ranged from 5.11 to 5.05 during 30 wk of aging`

ammonia.reason: No ammonia quantified; 1-2 mo age with low amino acid deamination and vacuum aging limits NH3.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-Cresol and indole not detected in cheese; clean pasteurized washed-curd make.

bitter.reason: Washed-curd removes lactose and limits hydrophobic peptides from chymosin/plasmin despite short age.

blue_moldy.reason: 2-Heptanone 0.42 ppm and 2-nonanone 1.73 ppm from fatty acid beta-oxidation but no Penicillium roqueforti.

browning.reason: Cold-water wash lowers residual lactose/galactose, so Maillard with 24.5% protein is moderate on heating.

buttery.reason: Mean diacetyl 8.81 ppm plus acetoin 0.11 ppm from Lactococcus lactis biovar diacetylactis citrate metabolism.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Low-moderate lipolysis: total FFA ~736 mg/kg; butanoic 7.74 ppm, hexanoic 31.74 ppm, octanoic 203.49 ppm headspace.

creaminess.reason: 30.28% fat and 41.01% moisture with young intact milkfat globules lubricating rennet gel.

crumbliness.reason: Pliable rennet, washed low-acid curd at pH 5.05 deforms rather than fractures.

firmness.reason: Semi-hard 41% moisture washed curd cooked to 39C; calcium retained at pH 5.05 gives elastic firmness.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylacetaldehyde and 2-phenylethanol not detected in cheese; minimal Phe transamination.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate not detected; low esterase activity and short age limit ethyl esters.

goaty.reason: Cow milk lacks 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic acids; only straight-chain C6-C10 at low odor activity.

malty_nutty.reason: 2-/3-Methylbutanal not detected; limited Leu/Ile Strecker degradation due to wash and 1 mo age.

melt.reason: pH 5.05 demineralized para-casein with intact network flows freely; classic washed-curd melter.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-Octen-3-ol and 1-octen-3-one not detected; no linoleic acid lipoxygenase pathway.

oil_off.reason: 30.28% fat coalesces on heating to free oil; moderate lipolysis does not yet emulsify fat.

smoky.reason: Guaiacol not detected; typical make is unsmoked with no wood-smoke phenols.

sour_vinegar.reason: Acetic acid 1.17 ppm headspace, ~2.0-2.4 mg/g total from starter; wash removes lactose/lactate acidity.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water stretching; rennet gel flows isotropically, not aligned fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Methanethiol, DMS, DMDS not detected; pasteurization drives off H2S and Met catabolism is low.

sweet.reason: Residual carbohydrate ~3% plus diacetyl/acetoin sweetness enhanced by low salt 1.19% and wash.

umami.reason: Short 1 mo age limits Glu release by chymosin, plasmin and Lactococcus peptidases.
